title: Readout from Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent's Meeting with Ukrainian Prime Minister Yulia Svyrydenko
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with Ukrainian Prime Minister Yulia Svyrydenko on April 15, 2026, emphasizing President Trump's efforts for a lasting peace in Ukraine. The readout highlights US support for Ukraine's new IMF program, Ukraine's reform progress, and discusses Ukraine's financial and energy situation along with the Iran conflict. The US-Ukraine Reconstruction Investment Fund (URIF) received commendation, with its first investment approved in March 2026.
key_points: Secretary Bessent met with Ukrainian Prime Minister Yulia Svyrydenko on April 15, 2026
US support confirmed for Ukraine's new IMF program
Secretary highlighted Ukraine's progress on reforms
Meeting covered Ukraine's financial and energy situation
URIF first investment milestone approved in March 2026

As a diplomatic meeting readout rather than a substantive policy announcement, its direct market impact is limited.
